ONE-TIME SETUP

Your world. A second screen.

  1. Install the companion addon

    Extract AzerothLiveMap into your Anniversary Interface/AddOns folder. Restart WoW and enable it in the AddOns list.

    ↓ Download addon (.zip)
  2. Keep the position strip visible

    A small black-and-white strip appears in WoW’s top-left corner. Use /alm show if it is hidden. You can close the in-game map.

  3. Connect your game

    Choose Connect WoW here, then share the WoW window or its monitor. Keep this browser on your other monitor. The page reads the strip locally.

Use a desktop browser with screen sharing, such as Chromium on Linux. If detection fails, try /alm size 8 or select the strip manually. Minimized, hidden, or frozen capture sources cannot provide live updates.

Built for Anniversary 2.5.6. Outdoor zones and cities are the initial target; position may be unavailable in instances. Questie overlays are not included. Live-client verification is still required.
